The '''EM-Two probe droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used for probing things such as [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits. [[Unidentified EM-Two probe droid|One unit]] attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]].<ref name="Darth P">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
